@graph.name: 4 Day Ijen, Papuma Beach, Tumpak Sewu & Bromo Journey from Surabaya

review.reviewBody: Visited Ijen Bromo and tumpak sewu with the tour for 4 days 3 nights. Despite the small language barrier, we really enjoyed our time with the tour. Sam, the local guides and our drivers were all very helpful and friendly. Never once rushed us for anything. Gave us more than enough time to enjoy the attractions. I have to say tumpak sewu was definitely the highlight, strongly recommend going there with the tour as it is not very accessible otherwise. Home stays were warm, nice and welcoming. Special thanks to our driver for getting us everywhere in time with his fantastic skills!! Highly recommend this tour!!!
